desc.zh: Ascend 图编译配置（typed 为 AscendCompilationConfig）。子键：enable_npugraph_ex（默认 true）、enable_static_kernel（默认 false，静态形状场景按 batch_size 预编译算子）、enable_super_kernel（v0.30.0 新增，缺省时跟随 enable_static_kernel）、fuse_norm_quant / fuse_qknorm_rope / fuse_muls_add（v0.30.0 新增，默认均 true）；v0.23.0 另有 fuse_allreduce_rms。依赖链 super_kernel → static_kernel → npugraph_ex，硬件不支持时自动降级。
desc.en: Ascend graph-compilation config (typed as AscendCompilationConfig). Sub-keys: enable_npugraph_ex (default true), enable_static_kernel (default false, pre-compiles per-batch-size operator binaries for static shapes), enable_super_kernel (new in v0.30.0, inherits enable_static_kernel when omitted), fuse_norm_quant / fuse_qknorm_rope / fuse_muls_add (new in v0.30.0, all default true); v0.23.0 also has fuse_allreduce_rms. Dependency chain super_kernel -> static_kernel -> npugraph_ex with auto-downgrade on unsupported hardware.

version_note.zh: enable_super_kernel / fuse_muls_add 自 v0.30.0 起；fuse_allreduce_rms 仅 v0.23.0 有
version_note.en: enable_super_kernel / fuse_muls_add since v0.30.0; fuse_allreduce_rms exists only on v0.23.0

desc.zh: 融合算子配置。子键 fusion_ops_gmmswigluquant（默认 true）控制是否使用 GmmSwigluQuant 融合算子。pydantic 校验会拒绝未知子键。
desc.en: Fused-operator config. Sub-key fusion_ops_gmmswigluquant (default true) controls the GmmSwigluQuant fused operator. Pydantic validation rejects unknown sub-keys.

desc.zh: vLLM-Ascend 日志输出路径，默认 ~/ascend/log/vllm_ascend。
desc.en: vLLM-Ascend log output path; defaults to ~/ascend/log/vllm_ascend.

desc.zh: 与权重加载重叠的启动预热配置。
desc.en: Startup warmup configuration that overlaps with weight loading.

desc.zh: 面向 batch-job-aware 调度器的配置。v0.30.0 起顶层键废弃，请改用 scheduler_config.batch_job_sched_config。
desc.en: Config for the batch-job-aware scheduler. Top-level key deprecated since v0.30.0; use scheduler_config.batch_job_sched_config instead.

version_note.zh: v0.30.0 起顶层键废弃（仍可用，发 deprecation 警告），规范写法 scheduler_config.batch_job_sched_config
version_note.en: top-level key deprecated since v0.30.0 (still works with a warning); canonical form scheduler_config.batch_job_sched_config

desc.zh: LI-C8 的 reshape 优化（仅在 enable_sparse_li_c8 开启时生效）。v0.30.0 起从源码移除。
desc.en: Reshape optimization for LI-C8 (only takes effect when enable_sparse_li_c8 is on). Removed from source since v0.30.0.

desc.zh: 融合 combine 算子的通信量化模式，作为 comm_quant_mode 传给 npu_moe_distribute_combine_v2。有效范围见算子文档。
desc.en: Communication quantization mode for the fused combine op, passed as comm_quant_mode to npu_moe_distribute_combine_v2. See operator docs for valid values.

desc.zh: 投机解码的草稿 KV 滑窗：仅将草稿模型注意力限制在最近 N 个 token，目标模型仍用全上下文，输出质量不变。适配 eagle3/dflash/dspark 方法；长上下文运行时超出草稿训练长度导致接受率崩塌的场景使用。
desc.en: Draft KV sliding window for speculative decoding: caps only the draft model's attention to the most recent N tokens while the target model keeps full context, leaving output quality unchanged. Works with eagle3/dflash/dspark; for long contexts where the draft's acceptance collapses beyond its trained length.

desc.zh: 内联 msprobe dump 配置，vLLM-Ascend 会物化为临时 JSON 文件传给调试器。
desc.en: Inline msprobe dump configuration; vLLM-Ascend materializes it to a temporary JSON file passed to the debugger.

desc.zh: msprobe dump 的配置文件路径（兼容旧版选项）。
desc.en: Path to the msprobe dump configuration file (legacy-compatible option).

requires: eplb_config 中需设置 dynamic_eplb: true 且需环境变量 DYNAMIC_EPLB=true 作为安全防护

desc.zh: 启用动态专家并行负载均衡（Dynamic EPLB）。属于 eplb_config 子配置；旧版需配合环境变量 DYNAMIC_EPLB=true。
desc.en: Enable dynamic Expert Parallelism Load Balancer. Part of eplb_config; legacy mode also requires the DYNAMIC_EPLB=true env var as a safety guard.

desc.zh: 动态投机解码（Dynamic Speculative Decoding）配置。
desc.en: Configuration for Dynamic Speculative Decoding.

desc.zh: PD 分离解码节点 DyntraLB 负载均衡配置。仅配置在 Decode 节点上。v0.30.0 起顶层键废弃，请改用 scheduler_config.dyntra_lb_config。
desc.en: DyntraLB load-balancing config for the decode node in P/D disaggregation — configure on the Decode node only. Top-level key deprecated since v0.30.0; use scheduler_config.dyntra_lb_config instead.

version_note.zh: v0.30.0 起顶层键不再解析（extra=forbid 会报未知键错误），必须写 scheduler_config.dyntra_lb_config 嵌套形式
version_note.en: top-level key no longer parsed since v0.30.0 (extra=forbid raises an unknown-key error); must use the nested form scheduler_config.dyntra_lb_config

desc.zh: 启用均衡调度。v0.30.0 起顶层键废弃（发 deprecation 警告），请改用 scheduler_config.enable_balance_scheduling。
desc.en: Enable balance scheduling. Top-level key deprecated since v0.30.0 (deprecation warning); use scheduler_config.enable_balance_scheduling instead.

version_note.zh: 顶层键废弃

desc.zh: 启用上下文并行（Context Parallel）。
desc.en: Enable Context Parallelism.

version_note.zh: v0.18 及更早通过环境变量支持；后被 enable_dsa_cp 取代
version_note.en: Env var only up to v0.18; superseded by enable_dsa_cp

desc.zh: 在 ARM 服务器上启用昇腾原生 CPU 绑定。设为 false 可禁用。
desc.en: Enable Ascend-native CPU binding on ARM servers. Set to false to disable.

desc.zh: 启用 DSA 注意力的上下文并行，与 PCP 互斥。main 分支已移除——开启时会收到明确报错，提示改用 PCP。
desc.en: Enable context parallel for DSA attention; mutually exclusive with PCP. Removed on main — enabling it now raises an explicit error telling you to use PCP instead.

desc.zh: 启用 SP MoE 的 FlashComm1 通信优化。仅 Model Runner V1 支持且需序列并行；MRv2 下启用会报配置错误，请改用 PCP。
desc.en: Enable FlashComm1 for SP MoE. Model Runner V1 only and requires sequence parallelism; errors on MRv2 — use PCP instead.

desc.zh: FlashComm2 并行规模，0 表示禁用。
desc.en: FlashComm2 parallel size; 0 disables it.

version_note.zh: v0.23.0 为配置键 + 环境变量回退；v0.30.0 已移除
version_note.en: Config key + env fallback in v0.23.0; removed in v0.30.0

desc.zh: 强制使用确定性轮询专家路由，仅用于性能分析。会替换真实 MoE 路由，导致模型结果与精度无效，切勿用于生产。
desc.en: Force deterministic round-robin expert routing, for profiling only. Replaces real MoE routing so model output/accuracy is invalid — never use in production.

desc.zh: 融合 MC2（MoE dispatch/combine）配置。A5 上 MegaMoe 需 SiTU 模型暴露 CANN MegaMoe 包装器。
desc.en: Fused MC2 (MoE dispatch/combine) configuration. On A5, MegaMoe requires SiTU models to expose the CANN MegaMoe wrapper.

desc.zh: 启用 KV cache 的 NZ 布局，仅对使用 MLA 的模型（如 DeepSeek）生效。
desc.en: Enable NZ layout for KV cache; only effective for MLA models such as DeepSeek.

desc.zh: 启用 KVPP（KV 流水线并行），把 MLA/SFA 非混合模型在 TP 各 rank 间冗余的 KV cache 按层分摊，同等显存容纳更多上下文 token 或并发请求。Experimental；仅支持 eager 或 PIECEWISE 图模式；PD 分离时只能在 prefill 节点开启。
desc.en: Enable KVPP (KV pipeline parallelism), distributing otherwise-replicated KV caches across TP ranks by layer for non-hybrid MLA/SFA models, so the same HBM fits more context tokens or concurrent requests. Experimental; eager or PIECEWISE graph mode only; for P/D disaggregation enable on the prefill node only.

desc.zh: 启用 Matmul 与 AllReduce 融合优化。
desc.en: Enable fused Matmul+AllReduce optimization.

version_note.zh: v0.23.0 仅环境变量；v0.30.0 已移除
version_note.en: Env var only in v0.23.0; removed in v0.30.0

desc.zh: 通过 ROCE 启用 dispatch/combine 算子的节点间通信。已弃用，将由 mc2_comm_alg="hierarchy" 取代。
desc.en: Enable inter-node RoCE communication for dispatch/combine ops. Deprecated, replaced by mc2_comm_alg="hierarchy".

desc.zh: 启用 MLAPO（模型逐层自适应并行优化）。
desc.en: Enable MLAPO (Model Layer-wise Adaptive Parallel Optimization).

desc.zh: PCP size > 1 时，在每个 TP 分片内对 embedding 与 LM Head 权重跨 PCP rank 分片。与 batch-sharded sampling 及这两个模块的细粒度 TP 不兼容。
desc.en: When PCP size > 1, shard embedding and LM Head weights across PCP ranks within each TP shard. Incompatible with batch-sharded sampling and fine-grained TP for these modules.

desc.zh: PCP 是否在组内对 O 投影权重分片（SFA-PCP 的 o_proj 与 DSA-PCP 两阶段 wo_a/wo_b）。不支持的权重方法/PCP 分区会警告并自动禁用；其他注意力后端不使用此选项。
desc.en: Whether PCP shards O-projection weights inside the group (SFA-PCP o_proj and DSA-PCP two-stage wo_a/wo_b). Auto-disabled with a warning when unsupported; unused by other attention backends.

desc.zh: 为 prefill 批次预留 mc2_token_capacity（用 max_num_batched_tokens 计算）。临时开关，未来 MC2 完备后默认启用并移除。
desc.en: Reserve mc2_token_capacity for prefill batches using max_num_batched_tokens. Temporary switch; will be removed once MC2 is complete.

desc.zh: 在 TP rank 间复制共享专家权重并以数据并行运行。提升性能但消耗更多内存，与上游 MoE 序列并行相互独立。
desc.en: Replicate shared-expert weights across TP ranks and run them data-parallel. Improves performance at higher memory cost; independent of upstream MoE sequence parallelism.

models: GLM-5 系列、DeepSeek 稀疏注意力模型
removed_in: v0.30.0（被 derive_and_validate 无条件覆盖，additional-config 传入无效）

desc.zh: 为稀疏注意力（Lightning Indexer）启用 C8 KV cache 布局。v0.23.0 可经 additional-config 设置；v0.30.0 起改为派生量：由 --attention_config.indexer_kv_dtype ∈ {fp8, int8} 自动决定（且要求模型为稀疏注意力模型），传本键不再生效。
desc.en: C8 KV cache layout for sparse attention (Lightning Indexer). Settable via additional-config on v0.23.0; derived since v0.30.0 — automatically decided by --attention_config.indexer_kv_dtype ∈ {fp8, int8} (requires a sparse-attention model); passing this key has no effect.

version_note.zh: v0.30.0 起由 --attention_config.indexer_kv_dtype fp8/int8 派生

models: GLM-5 / GLM-5.2 等 SFA 模型
removed_in: v0.30.0（被 derive_and_validate 无条件覆盖，additional-config 传入无效）

desc.zh: 为 SFA（Sparse Flash Attention）稀疏注意力启用 C8 KV cache 布局。v0.23.0 可经 additional-config 设置；v0.30.0 起改为派生量：由 --kv-cache-dtype ∈ {fp8, int8} 自动决定（且要求模型为 SFA 稀疏注意力模型），传本键不再生效。
desc.en: C8 KV cache layout for SFA (Sparse Flash Attention). Settable via additional-config on v0.23.0; derived since v0.30.0 — automatically decided by --kv-cache-dtype ∈ {fp8, int8} (requires an SFA sparse-attention model); passing this key has no effect.

version_note.zh: v0.30.0 起由 --kv-cache-dtype fp8/int8 派生

desc.zh: 是否启用按块转置 KV cache（融合算子路径）。
desc.en: Whether to enable block-wise transposed KV cache (fused-op path).

desc.zh: EPLB（专家并行负载均衡）配置。dynamic_eplb 启用动态均衡；expert_map_record_path 录制映射；expert_map_path 加载静态映射。
desc.en: EPLB (Expert Parallelism Load Balancer) config. dynamic_eplb enables dynamic balancing; expert_map_record_path records maps; expert_map_path loads static maps.

desc.zh: 细粒度张量并行配置。
desc.en: Configuration for fine-grained tensor parallelism.

desc.zh: Hamming 稀疏注意力配置，dict 含 enabled 与 sparse_json_location（稀疏 JSON 文件路径，须真实存在）。v0.30.0 起从源码移除。
desc.en: Hamming sparse attention config; dict with enabled and sparse_json_location (path to a real sparse JSON file). Removed from source since v0.30.0.

desc.zh: 为 KV pool 的整键操作、逐层范围和提交操作输出 JSON 审计日志。仅在调试时开启，正常运行保持禁用以避免日志开销。
desc.en: Emit per-layer KVPool ranged-transfer audit events as JSON. Debug only; keep disabled in production to avoid logging overhead.

values.\"hierarchy\": 层次化算法（仅 A2/A3 支持）
values.\"fullmesh_v2\": 全互联 v2（目前仅 A3 支持）

desc.zh: dispatch/combine 算子的通信算法选择，将取代 enable_mc2_hierarchy_comm。
desc.en: Communication algorithm for dispatch/combine ops; supersedes enable_mc2_hierarchy_comm.

desc.zh: 融合 MC2/MegaMoe 路径中 dispatch 后每个 rank 的 token 容量参考值。超出可能出现精度下降，需按实际 expert 负载调整。
desc.en: Per-rank token capacity after dispatch in the fused MC2/MegaMoe path. Exceeding it may degrade accuracy; tune to actual expert load.

desc.zh: 混合放置模式（DP×TP 平面上的专家/权重放置策略），计入 RFork 权重传输的兼容性指纹；发送端与接收端配置不一致会导致指纹不匹配。
desc.en: Mixed placement mode (expert/weight placement on the DP×TP plane); counted into the RFork weight-transfer compatibility fingerprint — a sender/receiver mismatch breaks the fingerprint.

desc.zh: MLAPO 下在 kv_consumer（仅 decode 的 D 节点）保留 prefill 权重而非释放。用 NPU 内存换取稳定性，规避权重释放后本地 prefill 路径崩溃（issue
desc.en: Keep MLAPO prefill weights on kv_consumer (decode-only D nodes) instead of freeing them. Trades NPU memory for stability against local-prefill crashes after weight freeing (issue

desc.zh: msmonitor 是否使用守护进程模式。
desc.en: Whether msmonitor uses daemon mode.

desc.zh: 为 DeepSeek V4 启用 DSA 多流重叠。
desc.en: Enable DSA multi-stream overlap for DeepSeek V4.

default: 硬件派生（A5 默认 true，其余 false）
models: DeepSeek V4.1 等 Engram 模型

desc.zh: Engram 模块多流重叠。默认仅在 A5（FP8 优化设备家族）开启；显式设置覆盖默认策略。FULL 图需在消费者侧等待描述符相关的外部事件，故默认策略因硬件而异。
desc.en: Multistream overlap for the Engram module. Defaults to on only on A5 (FP8-optimized device family); explicit settings override. FULL graphs wait on descriptor-specific external events at consumers, hence the hardware-dependent default.

desc.zh: 启用多流重叠门控，仅对含共享专家的 MoE 模型生效。已移除（v0.30.0 起源码无读取点）。
desc.en: Enable multistream overlap gating; only effective for MoE models with shared experts. Removed (no source read site since v0.30.0).

version_note.zh: v0.30.0 起已移除

desc.zh: 启用多流共享专家重叠，仅对含共享专家的 MoE 模型生效。
desc.en: Enable multi-stream overlap for the shared expert; only effective on MoE models with shared experts.

name.zh: PA 算子 shape 列表

desc.zh: page attention 算子的自定义 shape 列表。
desc.en: Custom shape list for page-attention ops.

desc.zh: 动态分块流水线并行（profiling chunk）配置。v0.30.0 起顶层键废弃，请改用 scheduler_config.profiling_chunk_config。
desc.en: Dynamic-chunk pipeline-parallel (profiling chunk) config. Top-level key deprecated since v0.30.0; use scheduler_config.profiling_chunk_config instead.

version_note.zh: v0.30.0 起顶层键废弃（仍可用，发 deprecation 警告），规范写法 scheduler_config.profiling_chunk_config
version_note.en: top-level key deprecated since v0.30.0 (still works with a warning); canonical form scheduler_config.profiling_chunk_config

desc.zh: 启用重计算调度器。仅在 PD 分离的 D 节点（kv_consumer）有效；在 P 节点或 PD-mixed 模式下启用会在启动时报明确错误。v0.30.0 起顶层键废弃，请改用 scheduler_config.recompute_scheduler_enable。
desc.en: Enable the recompute scheduler. Effective only on the decode node (kv_consumer) of a P/D disaggregation; enabling on a prefill node or PD-mixed mode raises an explicit startup error. Top-level key deprecated since v0.30.0; use scheduler_config.recompute_scheduler_enable instead. mode fails startup with a clear error.

version_note.zh: v0.30.0 起顶层键废弃（仍可用，发 deprecation 警告），规范写法 scheduler_config.recompute_scheduler_enable
version_note.en: top-level key deprecated since v0.30.0 (still works with a warning); canonical form scheduler_config.recompute_scheduler_enable

desc.zh: 是否刷新全局 Ascend 配置内容。通常用于 RLHF 或 ut/e2e 测试用例。
desc.en: Whether to refresh the global Ascend configuration. Usually used by RLHF or ut/e2e tests.

desc.zh: 拒绝采样器配置（block verify 与 entropy verify）。
desc.en: Rejection sampler configuration (block verify and entropy verify).

desc.zh: 一键 RL 模式总开关（enabled: true 时强制 weight_nz_mode=0、设置 VLLM_SERVER_DEV_MODE=1 等固定行为）。子键含 sleep_mode_extra_cleanup、enable_training_consistency、enable_batch_invariant。
desc.en: One-click RL mode (enabled: true forces weight_nz_mode=0, VLLM_SERVER_DEV_MODE=1, etc.). Sub-keys include sleep_mode_extra_cleanup, enable_training_consistency, enable_batch_invariant.

desc.zh: 启动时叠加层，与运行时配置默认值合并（检测器、dump 配额、报告标志）。
desc.en: Startup overlay merged into runtime config defaults (detectors, dump quota, report flags).

version_note.zh: main 分支新增，下一版本发布
version_note.en: New on main; ships in the next release

desc.zh: 启用 runtime_config.json 热重载（仅启动时生效；不是 JSON 字段）。
desc.en: Enable hot-reload of runtime_config.json (startup-only; not a JSON field).

version_note.zh: main 分支新增，下一版本发布
version_note.en: New on main; ships in the next release

desc.zh: Runtime Guard JSON 配置路径，默认 /runtime/config/runtime_config.json。
desc.en: Path to the Runtime Guard JSON config. Default: /runtime/config/runtime_config.json.

version_note.zh: main 分支新增，下一版本发布
version_note.en: New on main; ships in the next release

desc.zh: 设置 KV dump 根目录（dump.dump_dir），默认由报告根目录派生。已移除，请改用 runtime_config.dump.dump_dir。
desc.en: Set the KV dump root directory (dump.dump_dir), derived from the report root by default. Removed; use runtime_config.dump.dump_dir instead.

version_note.zh: Runtime Guard 特性的一部分，main 分支新增
version_note.en: Part of Runtime Guard; new on main

desc.zh: 覆盖报告根目录，默认 /runtime/report。已移除，请改用 runtime_config.report_dir。
desc.en: Override the report root directory (default /runtime/report). Removed; use runtime_config.report_dir instead.

version_note.zh: Runtime Guard 特性的一部分，main 分支新增
version_note.en: Part of Runtime Guard; new on main

desc.zh: 调度器扩展配置的规范层级，包含均衡调度、重计算调度、DyntraLB、ShortRequestFirst、动态分块流水线并行等。过渡期旧顶层键仍兼容但已弃用。
desc.en: Canonical nesting for scheduler extensions: balance scheduling, recompute scheduling, DyntraLB, ShortRequestFirst, dynamic chunked pipeline parallel, etc. Legacy top-level keys still parse but are deprecated.

desc.zh: SFA 注意力在 DCP（Decode Context Parallel）下强制 T-major 布局恢复，仅调试/兼容用途，正常部署无需设置。
desc.en: Force T-major layout restore for SFA attention under DCP (Decode Context Parallel). Debug/compatibility only — no need to set in normal deployments.

desc.zh: ShortRequestFirst prefill 调度配置，用于 FCFS 同步/异步、PD-prefill（P）或 PD-mixed 节点。v0.30.0 起顶层键废弃，请改用 scheduler_config.short_request_first_config。
desc.en: ShortRequestFirst prefill scheduling config for FCFS sync/async, PD-prefill (P) or PD-mixed nodes. Top-level key deprecated since v0.30.0; use scheduler_config.short_request_first_config instead.

version_note.zh: v0.30.0 起顶层键废弃（仍可用，发 deprecation 警告），规范写法 scheduler_config.short_request_first_config
version_note.en: top-level key deprecated since v0.30.0 (still works with a warning); canonical form scheduler_config.short_request_first_config

desc.zh: 稀疏 KV cache 卸载到 DRAM 的配置。子键：enabled、topk_buffer_size（-1 自动解析为 (1+投机 token 数)×2048）、dram_size_per_dp_GB（110）、keep_device_kv_cache、use_fused_overlap。仅 950 系列产品（A5）；勿在 prefill 节点设置。
desc.en: Config for offloading sparse KV cache to DRAM. Sub-keys: enabled, topk_buffer_size (-1 resolves to (1+num_speculative_tokens)*2048), dram_size_per_dp_GB (110), keep_device_kv_cache, use_fused_overlap. 950-series products (A5) only; do not set on prefill nodes.

values.1: 仅对量化权重启用 NZ
values.2: 在支持的情况下也对 BF16/FP16 权重启用 NZ

desc.zh: 权重 NZ 格式模式。0 禁用，1 仅量化权重，2 扩展至 BF16/FP16。
desc.en: Weight NZ layout mode. 0 disables NZ, 1 enables for quantized weights only, 2 extends to BF16/FP16 when supported.

desc.zh: 权重预取配置。已移除（v0.30.0 起源码无读取点）。
desc.en: Weight prefetch config. Removed (no source read site since v0.30.0).
